ios.desc:
Foku is a beautifully designed Pomodoro focus timer that helps you stay productive and build consistent work habits.

Whether you're studying, working, coding, or creating — Foku keeps you in the zone with timed focus sessions followed by short and long breaks. The classic Pomodoro technique, reimagined with a clean, minimal interface.

HOW IT WORKS
- Start a focus session (default 25 minutes, fully customizable)
- Take a short break when the timer ends
- After completing a full cycle, enjoy a longer break
- Repeat and watch your productivity grow

FEATURES
- Pomodoro Timer: Fully customizable focus, short break, and long break durations
- Live Activity & Dynamic Island: See your timer right on your lock screen and Dynamic Island
- Home Screen Widgets: Small and medium widgets showing today's focus time, sessions, and streak
- Statistics: Daily, weekly, and monthly charts to visualize your progress
- Session History: Review every completed session with duration and type
- Streaks: Build a daily focus streak and stay motivated with an activity grid
- Activity Grid: See your focus consistency over the last 5 weeks at a glance
- Custom Color Themes: 7 themes to personalize your focus space (2 free, 5 Pro)
- Cycles: Set custom sessions per cycle for your ideal workflow
- Notifications: Get alerted when your session or break ends
- Landscape Mode: Full landscape support for desk use

FOKU PRO
Unlock the full experience with Foku Pro:
- Full statistics with weekly and monthly charts
- Custom color themes (5 additional themes)
- Custom timer durations
- Auto-start breaks and focus sessions
- Minimal mode for distraction-free focus
- Support ongoing development

WHY FOKU?
Foku is built for people who value simplicity. No sign-ups, no clutter, no distractions — just you and your timer. Everything runs locally on your device, keeping your data private. No account required, ever.

PERFECT FOR
- Students studying for exams and building consistent study habits
- Professionals doing deep work and focused project sprints
- Developers, designers, and creators managing creative flow
- Anyone building better daily routines with the Pomodoro method

Start your free trial today and take your focus to the next level.
